This was their third success in a row. ==Asian Representation== * Again in another revamped and expanded [[2004 AFC Champions League|Asian Champions League]], last years runners up [[BEC Tero Sasana]] met their match and came bottom of a tough group comprising sides from China, South Korea and Japan. [[Krung Thai Bank FC|Krung Thai Bank]] also entered this year and came in second place in their group, although still not good enough to qualify for the knockout stages. ==Annual awards== ===Coach of the Year=== *{{flagicon|Thailand}} [[Worrawoot Dangsamer]] - [[Krung Thai Bank FC|Krung Thai Bank]] ===Player of the year=== *{{flagicon|Thailand}} [[Pichitphong Choeichiu]] - [[Krung Thai Bank FC|Krung Thai Bank]] ===Top scorer=== *{{flagicon|Thailand}} [[Vimol Jankam]] - 14 Goals[[Football records in Thailand]] [[Osotsapa FC|Osotsapa M 150]] ==Champions== The league champion was [[Krung Thai Bank F.C.|Krung Thai Bank]].
